headline: Nvidia reports tomorrow without Huang; Anthropic may price above $1.5T
bottomLine: Tech sold off into Nvidia's first results since Huang's exit, as Washington tightened AI-chip exports and Anthropic weighed lifting its IPO price. In the portfolio, SpaceX caught a Starship upper stage for the first time and Anduril unveiled an unmanned warship.

portfolio.title: SpaceX catches a Starship upper stage for the first time
portfolio.brief: After 22.5 hours in orbit, the Ship was caught by the launch tower on Saturday; the booster missed its catch and splashed down. The next flight will try to catch both stages.
portfolio.impact: A recoverable upper stage is the piece that makes Starship cheap enough for Starlink V3 and orbital data centers. The stock is still below its IPO price, so the catch has not been priced in yet.

sources.name: Space.com
sources.title: What's next for SpaceX's Starship after epic Flight 15 chopsticks catch?

portfolio.title: Anduril and HD Hyundai unveil an unmanned warship for the US Navy
portfolio.brief: The jointly built autonomous surface vessel was shown at HD Hyundai's Ulsan shipyard. It starts sea trials in Korea and moves to the US in early 2027 for testing.
portfolio.impact: Pairing with Korea's largest shipbuilder gives Anduril hulls at scale without building its own yard first, and positions it for the Navy's push toward unmanned fleets.

sources.name: KED Global
sources.title: HD Hyundai, Anduril launch unmanned warship, target US Navy contracts

thesis.title: The White House is now weighing in on who runs Nvidia
thesis.brief: Trump said a Huang return 'certainly isn't a bad idea' while Commerce finalized new AI-chip export limits and the Treasury Secretary publicly attacked the Commerce Secretary over enforcement.
thesis.impact: Who leads the world's key AI company and where its chips may go are now political decisions made in days. Our November essay predicted this; expect more of it.

sources.name: The National
sources.title: After Jensen Huang's resignation, US Commerce finalises AI export rule

thesis.title: Bitcoin sits near half its record while inflation runs hot
thesis.brief: Bitcoin touched $62K over the weekend, its lowest since July, even as October producer prices rose 6.5% year on year. Spot ETFs had seven straight days of outflows.
thesis.impact: We argued Bitcoin would win as money lost value. Right now it trades like a leveraged tech stock that falls when rates rise. That is the strongest evidence against the call this year.

sources.name: KuCoin
sources.title: Crypto daily market report, Nov 16: BTC touched $62K, ETF outflows, stablecoins shrink

thesis.title: Fed contacts now rank AI as a top financial-stability risk
thesis.brief: In the Fed's latest survey, 87% of contacts named AI-related risks, up from 50% in May, citing how the build-out is financed and the risk of a correction.
thesis.impact: The fragile, debt-funded AI boom in our 1873 essay is now the Fed's own worry. The other half of the call, that hard assets win, is not playing out yet.

sources.name: The Neuron
sources.title: Fed survey: 87% of contacts now name AI as a financial-stability risk

regulation.title: Commerce closes the cloud loophole for AI chips
regulation.brief: A final rule limits remote access to advanced AI chips through data centers abroad and requires licenses for AI exports to Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Brazil and Thailand.
regulation.impact: Renting US chips in Southeast Asia, the main workaround, now needs a license. Decentralized and confidential-compute networks with nodes in those countries take on new compliance risk.
regulation.next: Effective date and rule text still to publish; lawmakers are pushing for tighter controls.

sources.name: The National
sources.title: After Jensen Huang's resignation, US Commerce finalises AI export rule

regulation.title: Bank regulator finalizes the first stablecoin rules under the GENIUS Act
regulation.brief: The OCC's final rule sets reserve, redemption, audit and reporting requirements for the stablecoin issuers it supervises. The Fed is consulting on its own version.
regulation.impact: Stablecoin issuance now has a federal rulebook and a start date, which favors banks already under the OCC and makes non-bank issuers look riskier to partners.
regulation.next: Rule takes effect Jan 18, 2027; Fed proposals still out for comment.

sources.name: TokenPost
sources.title: OCC final rule moves US stablecoin law into implementation

regulation.title: Washington sues states to protect Kalshi's event contracts
regulation.brief: The US and the CFTC asked a federal court to stop Arkansas from treating Kalshi's contracts as illegal gambling, arguing federal derivatives law overrides the state. A similar suit targets Louisiana.
regulation.impact: The CFTC is fighting for exclusive control of new crypto-style derivatives. If it wins, perps and prediction venues get one national regulator instead of 50 state fights.
regulation.next: A federal court rules on preemption; the Louisiana case runs in parallel.

sources.name: Bitcoin.com News
sources.title: This Week in Crypto Law (November 15, 2026)

tech.title: ChatGPT gets a wallet so AI agents can pay; Shopify adopts an agent rulebook
tech.brief: OpenAI's ChatGPT Wallet lets agents buy for users with Face ID approval, built with Visa, Mastercard and Amex. Separately, Shopify switched on Sierra's Poppy protocol, which tells agents what stores allow.
tech.impact: Agent payments now run on card networks, inside the largest AI app. Startups selling agent-payment rails need a distribution partner, not just a product.

sources.name: The Neuron
sources.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet so agents can buy for users; Sierra's Poppy protocol adopted by Shopify

tech.title: Meituan releases a 1.6T-parameter model trained on Chinese chips
tech.brief: LongCat-2.5, an open-weight coding-agent model, was reportedly trained entirely on Chinese hardware; running it takes 194 Huawei Ascend chips.
tech.impact: On the day the US tightened chip exports, China showed a frontier-scale model built without them. Export controls slow China's labs but no longer stop them.

macro.title: Nvidia reports tomorrow, its first results since Huang quit
macro.brief: Shares are down about 13% since Thursday and the Nasdaq fell 2.5% today. Wall Street expects about $109B in revenue; Nvidia's board says it is not bringing Huang back.
macro.impact: Guidance, not the quarter, is the test: any sign customers are pausing orders would hit every AI valuation, and the reaction lands two days before Anthropic starts trading.

sources.title: Nvidia earnings preview: the first big test after Jensen Huang's exit

sources.title: Stock market today: Dow and S&P 500 drop, Nasdaq sinks over 2% as Nvidia leads AI trade lower, Anthropic IPO looms

macro.title: Anthropic weighs pricing its IPO above $1.5 trillion
macro.brief: Anthropic is reportedly looking to lift its valuation above $1.5T before pricing this week, even as the Nasdaq 100 sits about 10% off its high and October was the weakest month for share sales this year.
macro.impact: A higher price would raise the bar for every private AI round; a stumble after pricing would hit late-stage AI valuations right when several are raising.

sources.name: ION Analytics (Mergermarket)
sources.title: Anthropic explores IPO price hike even as equity deals slow amid hedge fund pain

macro.title: Bitcoin briefly drops to $62K as $2B of leveraged bets unwind
macro.brief: Bitcoin hit its lowest since July over the weekend before recovering to about $65K. Stablecoin supply fell $17B in a month and sentiment hit extreme fear.
macro.impact: Crypto liquidity is the thinnest since 2022 heading into year-end token unlocks. Expect unlocks to meet very few buyers.

macro.title: Oil falls as the IEA sees the first surplus since the war began
macro.brief: US crude fell 3.7% to about $85 after the IEA said supply now exceeds demand by about 2M barrels a day this quarter.
macro.impact: Cheaper oil is the one piece of relief for inflation; if it holds, it softens the case for a big December rate hike.

sources.name: Yahoo Finance
sources.title: Oil falls as IEA sees first supply surplus since the war began

frontier.title: OpenAI's next model helped write a proof defining the Standard Model on a grid
frontier.brief: An OpenAI paper co-written with its unreleased GPT-6 Astra proposes a rigorous mathematical definition of particle physics on a spacetime lattice. Physicist Nathaniel Craig says the model helped build the proof.
frontier.impact: A long-standing gap in the foundations of physics is now being attacked with AI. It is a research claim, not yet peer-reviewed, but it is the clearest sign yet that AI is doing real theoretical physics.

sources.name: The Neuron
sources.title: OpenAI paper with GPT-6 Astra proposes a mathematical definition of the Standard Model on a spacetime grid
